dedupe_keys.name: 142 city 100 metre heat stress projections to 2100

description: This Zenodo release packages high-resolution climate, heat-stress and impact indicators for 142 cities worldwide. The article states that UrbClim downscaled climate information to 100-metre urban grids, then summarized hourly results into decadal indicators from 2010 to 2100. It reports 34 heat-stress indicators under three future scenarios, including overshoot pathways. The public repository lists country ZIP archives and a small processing-scripts archive under CC BY 4.0. Coverage is selected city extents and their rural surroundings, not a continuous global grid or measured heat exposure at every building. These are modelled scenarios, not weather forecasts; emission pathways, downscaling choices and city selection are limitations. A reviewer-assessed simulation use is stress-testing cooling demand, public-space exposure or health-service scenarios across heat pathways. data-nex-gddp-cmip6 is related climate projection context at another scale. The linked dashboard is a presentation layer for this release, not counted here as a second dataset. No archive or processing script was downloaded or run.
